verdict.rationale: UCP is a versioned open protocol. A probe confirms dated spec releases and an API-version header, the spec and reference implementations are public on GitHub, profiles declare the protocol version, and the CLI's `--input-schema` fetches live input schemas. The only validation tooling evidenced is the AI Toolkit's GraphQL/Liquid/Extensions schema checks, which are adjacent, and server-side profile negotiation errors, which are not a conformance tool. missing for 10: a UCP conformance test suite or payload validator, independent corroboration of schema-based validation for UCP payloads.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against a versioned commerce protocol with a published schema and conformance or validation tooling

citations.quote: https://ucp.dev/llms.txt serves the versioned specification index
The complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations are hosted in our public GitHub repository.
a platform profile is a JSON document that describes the protocol version and capabilities the platform supports
Use `--input-schema` against any of these commands to fetch the merchant's live input schema before composing a payload.
